text: Those enemies whose skill falls short shall find it ever harder to withstand the Champion Swordsmen.
Beneath the watchful gaze of the Wolf Lord, the pack tears through the enemies of the War God with the virtue of courage.
As wrath overtakes them, the penitents shall offer blood in tribute to fallen comrades of old.
In the long night, the threat of the undead has forged these hunters who keep watch for the light amid the darkness.
The members of the Order of the Golden Firstborn are not the Empire's finest warriors, but their boundless heroic fervor drives them to shed their blood for the Empire.
To fight alongside a legend is a dream every Imperial warrior yearns for; every action of these great warriors is enough to stir the hearts of the army.
When the Winds of Magic are blocked and the echoes of spellcraft fade into the void, even the mightiest sorcerers can only perish in the silence.
The Legion of a Thousand Men are the guardians of the temple, followers of Sigmar's holy power, and an unyielding shield sworn to protect the Empire and its faith.
Blood and fire rain down as steel and faith resound together, sword and gun executing heaven's judgment as one.
Blood and blade clash in sparks, and the faithful carry out their devotion through battle.
The wills bound within the machinery are awakened once more, baptized in blood and fire.
The loyal pack shall tear apart their pitiable prey as one.
As the sarcophagus roars into motion, its scalding steam shall scorch any foe who dares draw near.

From the day these eight legendary swordsmen became the Throne Guard, they swore to protect the Empire's leader to their final breath, and they shall spend the rest of their lives proving their word true.
Sigmar's power leaps forth from the flash of their blades, and the guardsmen's bodies shine with divine light.
Even in the face of boundless darkness, there will always be those who keep watch for the dawn.
The children of the Goddess of War have devoted their entire lives to studying the art of war, unleashing it without reserve in the contest of blood and iron.
As you sing the hymn of Sigmar's divine power, the God-Emperor's gaze shall fall upon every faithful believer.
Though not true wizards, the Twilight Knights can still skillfully wield the power of the Eight Winds to bind their foes.
